longDescription.en-US: Search and reference your documents in Box and work safely with Box content flows from Codex.
longDescription.zh-CN: 在 Box 中搜索和引用文档，并从 Codex 安全处理 Box 内容流程。

defaultPrompt: Find a Box file and summarize the key points

skillPreviews.name: box-content-api
skillPreviews.description: Build and troubleshoot Box integrations for uploads, folders, folder listings, downloads and previews, shared links, collaborations, search, metadata, event-driven automations, and Box AI retrieval flows. Use when Codex needs to add Box APIs or SDKs to an app, wire Box-backed document workflows, organize or share content, react to new files, or fetch Box content for search, summarization, extraction, or question-answering.
